title: Full Moon in Taurus · October 26
summary: Moon in Taurus, Sun in Scorpio – holding on meets letting go. An earthy, sensual night that asks what truly gives you security. Dreams this night are physical and intense: the body, home, possessions, clutching something that slips away. What are you holding on to – and how much of it may you let go?

title: New Moon in Libra · October 10
summary: Sun and Moon united in Libra – harmony, fairness and the question of the we. A gentle fresh start for relationship, balance and beauty. Dreams this night are quiet and relational: encounters, mirrors, decisions, the feeling of balance. Where may you come back into balance – with others and with yourself?

title: Full Moon in Aries · September 26
summary: Moon in Aries, Sun in Libra – self-assertion meets harmony. A fiery, awakening night in which the question of the self and the we comes to a head. Dreams this night are direct and intense: conflict, fire, courage, pent-up anger that often reveals a boundary. Where have you held back too long to keep the peace?

title: New Moon in Virgo · September 11
summary: Sun and Moon united in the sign of order. A fresh start for clarity, healing and everyday life – and the quiet permission to be good enough. Dreams this night are tender and detailed: tidying up, tasks, the body, the feeling of being judged. What in your life wants to come back into order?

title: Full Moon in Pisces · August 28
summary: Moon in Pisces, Sun in Virgo – dissolution meets order. The dream full moon of the year: the border between waking and dreaming grows thin as mist. Dreams this night are vivid, spiritual and emotional – water, blurring, music, the sense of something greater. Hold on to them before they dissolve.

title: New Moon in Leo · August 12
summary: Sun and Moon united in the fire of the heart. A fresh start for everything that wants to be seen – courage, creativity, self-expression. Dreams this night are tender and fleeting, yet often circle stages, visibility and being a child. The quiet question beneath: who would you be if you were enough for yourself?
